retint.name: back-canvas
retint.source: TRELLIS reconstructed the satchel's unseen back panel and the rear strip of its lid near-black on every seed (facing luma 2 sRGB against 93 to 121 on the front and sides). Target: the median canvas colour of the reconstruction's own front panel, sRGB (164, 124, 62), so the back reads as the same canvas as the front; the concept itself shows only the front. The roll and handle lie in front of y 0.075 m and are not repainted.

materials.provenance: Base colour re-baked (Cycles CPU, emission, selected-to-active, supersampled) from the approved TRELLIS source mesh, then any declared colour repairs the recipe lists (matchBoxes, retint, facingBalance); tangent normals baked from the approved source mesh and whiteout-blended with relief derived from colour; AO baked from the decimated geometry; roughness and metalness from recipe colour classes. Artistic derivation, not measured PBR.

tangentRepair.why: three.js normalizes vertex tangents in the vertex shader; a zero-length tangent becomes NaN and the bloom spreads it.

settings.POSITION: SHORT normalized about the bounding-box centre with one uniform scale; the scale and centre folded into the root node
settings.TEXCOORD: UNSIGNED_SHORT normalized where the UVs lie in [0, 1]

reorder.method: meshoptimizer reorderMesh: vertex-cache triangle order, then vertex-fetch vertex order
reorder.check: a permutation: every vertex keeps its exact attribute bytes, and the triangles are the same, with the same winding, in another order

geometryCompression.check: every view decoded again: attribute views byte-identical to the reordered data; triangle index views hold the same triangles in the same order and winding (only the first vertex may rotate)

derivedFrom.note: The exact ship-001-t-q output, reordered for locality and compressed by meshopt_glb.mjs (EXT_meshopt_compression, no lossy filters); the Blender cook was not re-run.
The exact ship-001-t output, quantized by quantize_prop_glb.py; the Blender cook was not re-run.
The exact ship-001 output, tangents checked and degenerate ones repaired by repair_tangents.py; the Blender cook was not re-run.

cook.scriptsNote: SHA-256 of each script with LF line endings, equal to its copy in scripts/models/pipeline.
cook.verification: tests/pickup-models.test.ts checks one static mesh and material within the triangle budget, normals, tangents and WebP maps, and drives the pickup pools without a DOM (one instanced draw per kind with no instance colour, the procedural pickup's size and height, its bob and the coin's spin, no motion under reduced motion); tests/models-browser.test.ts decodes its maps and tests/props-browser.test.ts renders the pickups on the shader programs warmed at load.

limitations: Single-view TRELLIS reconstruction from one approved concept: the far side, back and underside are TRELLIS's invention, with no rear-view painting projected onto them.
Roughness, metalness and ambient occlusion are derived from colour classes and Cycles bakes, not measured PBR or hand-painted masks.
Re-cooking is not guaranteed to be byte-reproducible: MikkTSpace tangents can round differently on a few vertices.

Every TRELLIS seed painted the unseen back panel near-black (facing luma 2 sRGB against 93 to 121 elsewhere); a declared retint repaints it toward the reconstruction's own front canvas colour (sRGB 164, 124, 62), so the back reads as canvas but without the front's stitching and edging.
The canvas reads more like dyed leather than oiled canvas; the handle is a thin, soft tube; there is no red cross or medical emblem by design.
At 286,224 bytes it exceeds the batch F plan's 250 KB per pickup by 36 KB (the three 512 px WebP maps are 207 KB of it).
